skill.name: better-writing
skill.description: Writes and reviews your interface copy, from labels and errors to empty states and confirmations, so it matches your product's voice and tells people what to do next.
skill.summary: Write consistent interface copy with clear actions, helpful errors, and translation-ready messages.
skill.author: jakubkrehel

content.value_statement: Unclear labels and inconsistent messages leave people unsure what to do next. This skill writes and reviews interface copy using your existing vocabulary and voice.
actual_capabilities: Inventory existing interface strings, object names, action verbs, capitalization, and product voice before proposing changes.
Write action-focused buttons, descriptive links, positive toggle labels, and realistic input placeholders.
Rewrite errors with recovery steps and empty states with a clear next action.
Draft destructive confirmations, undo messages, and loading, success, failure, and partial-result copy.
Recommend complete messages with placeholders, locale-aware plurals, and Intl formatting instead of fragmented strings.
Report writing issues by severity with locations, before-and-after wording, user impact, and verification limits.
limitations: Typography, layout, colors, and accessibility markup are outside this skill's scope.
Server or CMS strings cannot be verified unless their content is available for inspection.
The skill provides writing guidance, not a standalone copy checker or automated test suite.
Localization guidance does not replace translation review or testing with your actual locale data.

use_cases.title: Review Copy Before Release
use_cases.description: Review component and locale strings for misleading labels, missing error recovery, and inconsistent terminology.

use_cases.title: Draft Product Flow Messages
use_cases.description: Write onboarding, empty-state, status, and destructive-confirmation copy that matches the product's established voice.

use_cases.title: Prepare Strings for Localization
use_cases.description: Identify fragmented sentences, English-only plural logic, and manually formatted dates before translation work begins.

prompt_templates.title: Improve One Error
prompt_templates.prompt: Rewrite this error with a clear recovery step: [message]. The action is [action], the cause is [cause], and recovery requires [step].
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: replace one vague error message.

prompt_templates.title: Write an Empty State
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft empty-state copy for [screen] using these existing strings: [examples]. Include a heading, useful context, and one action that the interface supports.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: draft copy within an existing product voice.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Destructive Flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [flow] against its actual behavior. Check consequences, affected people, confirmation or undo, action labels, and vocabulary. Provide before-and-after copy with severity and reasons.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Interface and Locale Strings
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect [components] and [locale files]. Inventory terminology and voice first. Review recovery, consistency, placeholders, plurals, and locale formatting. Report locations and mark unavailable strings unverified.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: perform a scoped writing audit across source and translations.

output_examples.input: Rewrite an upload error: Something went wrong. The upload failed because the connection dropped, and retrying is supported.
output_examples.output: Unable to upload the file. Check your connection and try again.

output_examples.input: Write confirmation copy for permanently deleting Q3 report and its four comments. Recovery is not available.
output: Body: This permanently deletes the report and its 4 comments. You cannot undo this.

output_examples.input: Write an empty state for a projects screen. Projects organize tasks and files, and users can create a project.
output: Description: Projects keep your tasks and files together.

best_practices: Provide surrounding strings, the product vocabulary, and any content style guide before requesting new copy.
Explain actual behavior, recovery options, and irreversible consequences so suggested wording remains accurate.
Review components and locale files together, and explicitly record any unavailable content.
anti_patterns: Inventing a new voice or terminology for one isolated screen.
Promising recovery, undo, or actions that the product does not support.
Building sentences from fragments or assuming every language has only singular and plural forms.

faq.question: What kind of writing does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers interface labels, links, errors, empty states, confirmations, status messages, and the vocabulary connecting them.

faq.question: Does it preserve an existing brand voice?
faq.answer: Yes. It starts with existing copy and flags voice differences only when they cause inconsistency, ambiguity, translation risk, or unsuitable tone.

faq.question: Can it help prepare copy for translation?
faq.answer: Yes. It recommends complete messages, placeholders, locale-aware plural rules, and Intl formatting. It does not guarantee translation quality.

faq.question: Does it fix accessibility markup or layout?
faq.answer: No. It addresses accessible wording, but delegates markup, announcements, typography, colors, and translated-string layout to other skills.

faq.question: How are writing-review results presented?
faq.answer: Findings include severity, location, original text, proposed text, and rationale. Unavailable strings are marked unverified rather than approved.

faq.question: Which assistants are listed as supported?
faq.answer: The marketplace report lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code. This package supplies Markdown guidance and examples rather than executable tooling.
